But if 30k has already appeared twice on the river and 60k once, the actual remaining is 3 outs (8 - 2 - 1 = 5 outs). At this moment, if another strategy can hit more of the remaining outs, even with fewer outs, the actual win rate may be higher.

strings.麻將聽牌張數（Tile Acceptance）是指你當前手牌在聽牌狀態下，能夠摸: Tenpai tile count (Tile Acceptance) refers to the total number of remaining tiles to draw to complete a winning hand from your current tenpai state. Calculation steps: first decompose your hand into melds (sequences + pungs) + a pair, identifying tile types that are one tile away from completing all melds. Then, for each waiting tile, check its remaining quantity—subtracting the counts of the same tiles in your hand and the 'dead' tiles already discarded or exposed on the table; the remainder is the actual number of tiles you can draw.

strings.麻將聽牌張數（Tile Acceptance）是指你當前手牌在聽牌狀態下，能夠摸: テンパイ牌数（Tile Acceptance）とは、現在の手牌がテンパイ状態にあるとき、和了を完成させることができる残りの牌の総数を指します。計算手順は次のとおりです。まず手牌を「面子（順子＋刻子）＋雀頭」の組み合わせ構造に分解し、すべての面子を完成させるのに差一枚で済む牌型を見つけます。次に、各聴牌の残り枚数を一枚ずつ確認します。自分の手牌にある同じ牌を除外し、場に出た牌や副露された“死牌”を除いた後に残るのが、実際に引くことができる枚数です。
